description: This file defines a simple class 'Range' that encapsulates a numeric range with minimum and maximum float values, providing methods to access these bounds and compute the width of the range.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: A class representing a numeric range with minimum and maximum bounds, providing methods to retrieve bounds and calculate the width.

methods.name: Range(double min, double max)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Range object, converting double inputs to floats.

methods.name: Range(float min, float max)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Range object with specified float bounds.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the range.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the range.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Calculates and returns the width of the range (max - min).
